greeting: Welcome to The Salty Sow! BEST inn on the coast!
Brine-Trotter's the name, hospitality's the GAME!
You look like you need a soft bed! I have BEDS!
Back again? Knew you'd prefer MY inn to... others.
The Salty Sow! Where the pork is fresh and the beds are DRY!
New guest? First drink's on the house! House is me!
Best seafood stew in Tide! Family recipe! Secret ingredients!
Stay at The Salty Sow! Leave the other inns to... lesser travelers!
dialog.room_offer: Rooms with OCEAN VIEWS! Hear the waves! Smell the salt! Sleep like a baby!
dialog.food_specialty: Try my Seafarer's Stew! Seven kinds of seafood! One kind of SECRET!
dialog.sooty_hog_rivalry: My cousin Hamhock runs The Sooty Hog in Ember. Claims HIS inn is better. HAH! Does he have OCEAN BREEZES? I think NOT! The Sooty Sow beats the Sooty Hog ANY day!
dialog.inn_history: The Salty Sow's been here forty years! Survived hurricanes, floods, and one very organized seagull attack!
rumor: Heard there's treasure in the deep. Divers won't shut up about it.
The aeronauts say a storm's coming. Big one. Stock up!
My cousin in Ember thinks he's SO great. Heat-shriveled pork! HAH!
Mire's inn? 'The Bogwater Bar.' Charming. NOT.
Tide and Ember inns have a... rivalry. Family thing.
dialog.travel_advice: Heading to Mire? Waterproof EVERYTHING. That fog gets into your SOUL.
farewell: Sweet dreams! The waves sing you to sleep!
Come back soon! The Salty Sow misses you already!
Safe travels! And tell Hamhock I'm winning!
Thanks for staying! Leave a review! Or just come back!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Stew's bubbling! Come get it!
dialog.time_night: Late night! For the night owls and sailors!

party_reactions.kade: Another themed inn. This one smells like... low tide.
party_reactions.twist: STEW! I'm SO hungry! What's in it?!
party_reactions.korr: A dry bed is a luxury. Even a slightly damp one.
party_reactions.renna: Do you have any rooms with... less salt in the air?
party_reactions.suresh: Hospitality in any environment shows character.
party_reactions.sova: Got a room with a window? Need line of sight.
party_reactions.grit: Better than a trench. Better than most barracks.
party_reactions.ashka: So much WATER here. Prefer heat.
party_reactions.senna: Back door? Good. I like options.
party_reactions.callum: Is... is the floor supposed to be wet?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! Getting the Salty Sow experience!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite guest! Your usual room's ready!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Practically family! Stay free! Eat free! Just... leave eventually!
